# konnect_dcr_provider (Resource)

DcrProvider Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_dcr_provider" "my_dcrprovider" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth0` (Attributes) Request body for creating an Auth0 DCR provider. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth0))
- `azure_ad` (Attributes) Request body for creating an Azure AD DCR provider. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure_ad))
- `curity` (Attributes) Request body for creating a Curity DCR provider. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--curity))
- `http` (Attributes) Request body for creating an HTTP DCR provider. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http))
- `kong_identity` (Attributes) Request body for creating a Kong Identity DCR provider. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kong_identity))
- `okta` (Attributes) Request body for creating an Okta DCR provider. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--okta))

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) At least one active auth strategy is using this DCR provider.
- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `dcr_provider_auth0` (Attributes) A DCR provider for Auth0 -- only properties not included in DcrProviderBase (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dcr_provider_auth0))
- `dcr_provider_azure_ad` (Attributes) A DCR provider for Azure AD -- only properties not included in DcrProviderBase (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dcr_provider_azure_ad))
- `dcr_provider_curity` (Attributes) A DCR provider for Curity -- only properties not included in DcrProviderBase (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dcr_provider_curity))
- `dcr_provider_http` (Attributes) A DCR provider for HTTP -- only properties not included in DcrProviderBase (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dcr_provider_http))
- `dcr_provider_kong_identity` (Attributes) A DCR provider for Kong Identity -- only properties not included in DcrProviderBase (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dcr_provider_kong_identity))
- `dcr_provider_okta` (Attributes) A DCR provider for Okta -- only properties not included in DcrProviderBase (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dcr_provider_okta))
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the DCR provider. This is used to identify the DCR provider in the Portal UI.
- `id` (String) Contains a unique identifier used for this resource.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer of the DCR provider.
- `name` (String) The name of the DCR provider. This is used to identify the DCR provider in the Konnect UI.
- `provider_type` (String) The type of DCR provider. Can be one of the following - auth0, azureAd, curity, okta, http
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

<a id="nestedatt--auth0"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth0`

Required:

- `dcr_config` (Attributes) Payload to create an Auth0 DCR provider. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth0--dcr_config))
- `issuer` (String) Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) The name of the DCR provider. This is used to identify the DCR provider in the Konnect UI. Requires replacement if changed.
- `provider_type` (String) must be "auth0"; Requires replacement if changed.

Optional:

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the DCR provider. This is used to identify the DCR provider in the Portal UI. Requires replacement if changed.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".
Requires replacement if changed.

<a id="nestedatt--auth0--dcr_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth0.dcr_config`

Required:

- `initial_client_id` (String) This ID should be copied from your identity provider's settings after you create a client
and assign it as the management client for DCR for this developer portal
Requires replacement if changed.
- `initial_client_secret` (String) This secret should be copied from your identity provider's settings after you create a client
and assign it as the management client for DCR for this developer portal
Requires replacement if changed.

Optional:

- `initial_client_audience` (String) This is the audience value used for the initial client.
If using a custom domain on Auth0, this must be set as to the Auth0 Management API audience value.
If left blank, the issuer will be used instead.
Requires replacement if changed.
- `use_developer_managed_scopes` (Boolean) Requires replacement if changed.

<a id="nestedatt--http--dcr_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http.dcr_config`

Required:

- `api_key` (String) This is the API Key that will be sent with each HTTP request to the custom DCR server. It can be
verified on the server to ensure that incoming requests are coming from Konnect.
Requires replacement if changed.
- `dcr_base_url` (String) The base URL of the DCR server. This is the URL that will be used to make the HTTP requests from Konnect to the DCR provider.
This URL must be accessible from the Konnect service.
Requires replacement if changed.

Optional:

- `allow_multiple_credentials` (Boolean) When enabled, indicates that the DCR provider supports creating and managing multiple credentials per application. Default: false; Requires replacement if changed.
- `disable_event_hooks` (Boolean) This flag disables all the event-hooks on the application flow for the DCR provider. Requires replacement if changed.
- `disable_refresh_secret` (Boolean) This flag disable the refresh-secret endpoint on the application flow for the DCR provider. Requires replacement if changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_dcr_provider.my_konnect_dcr_provider
  id = "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_dcr_provider.my_konnect_dcr_provider "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
```
